overall_assessment: All 18 packet entries (14 suspects and four random controls) were read in full as displayed; packet-builder truncation limits comparison of omitted passages and is not an extraction defect. Main sections and all displayed learning-outcome groups are generally preserved, but prerequisite loss, mixed sections, admission contamination and assessment logistics occur beyond the flagged sample, including in random controls. The empty flags mostly identify genuine placeholders, whereas Selvvalgt, the CBU1503 teaching-method leak flags and the admission-worded prior-course requirements are false alarms; the OPG3701 merge and duplicate flags are genuine.

findings.evidence: Emnet forutsetter bestått eksamen i russiske grunnemner; SPR1720 og SPR1721.
findings.description: The random SPR2721 control explicitly requires two completed Russian courses, but emits no prerequisites row. Its Opptakskrav heading maps to .drop, discarding subject-matter prerequisites along with admission text. This loss is not flagged by the pre-pass.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps opptakskrav unconditionally to .drop; the FHS reader does not distinguish course prerequisites within this heading from programme admission.
findings.suggested_fix: For FHS Opptakskrav blocks, retain sentences explicitly requiring prior knowledge or passed named courses as prerequisites, and discard only programme-admission and study-right statements.

findings.evidence: Emnet bygger på ING2320 og ING2321.
findings.description: The two engineering random controls state named prior courses in course_content but emit no prerequisites. Both CBU1503 offerings likewise leave the stated prior CBU1508 training in course_content. These prior-knowledge statements should be available under prerequisites; the pre-pass cannot detect their absence.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .split_inline_prerequisites() recognises prerequisite labels, but not unlabelled Emnet bygger på / The course is based on statements naming prior courses.
findings.suggested_fix: Add guarded sentence patterns for explicit builds-on statements followed by course codes, moving the prior-knowledge statement into prerequisites without moving descriptions of courses for which this course provides a foundation.

findings.evidence:
Arbeidsformer og læringsaktiviteter
Studentens styring av egen tid samt evt. etablering og gjennomføring av gruppearbeid, vil være påvirkende for læringsutbyttet.
findings.description: OPG3701 prerequisites absorb the thesis organisation and actual teaching/supervision paragraphs after the genuine prior-course requirement, confirming leak->teaching_methods. SPR2710 prerequisites similarly absorb the paragraph describing six thematic blocks and their materials. The leak->.drop flags themselves are false alarms: sentences beginning Opptak til emnet that require passed courses are valid prerequisites, including AR301 and SPR2711.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: OPG3701 Emnets oppbygning and Arbeidsformer og læringsaktiviteter are absent from the headings read. Once Forkunnskapskrav opens prerequisites, sectionize() carries subsequent mixed paragraphs forward; SPR2710 has no intervening explicit heading at all.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the FHS reader recognise the missing organisation/teaching labels as boundaries, mapping the teaching block to teaching_methods. Add a bounded rule for SPR2710-style Emnet er strukturert paragraphs so topic/material descriptions return to course_content instead of continuing prerequisites.

findings.evidence:
Praktisk organisering og arbeidsformer
Pedagogisk innretning
De teoretiske delene av emnet anvender egenstudier, gruppeoppgaver, forelesninger, foredrag og seminarundervisning.
findings.description: Whole mixed introduction and supplemental blocks are treated as subject matter. LED3201 course_content contains a lengthy teaching block also present in teaching_methods, confirming its leak flag. INGOF2230 retains the explicit seminar/group-work/feedback paragraph in course_content. LOG3105 supplemental text describes the assessed proposal deliverable. ING2318 and random ING3330 also retain teaching instructions in course_content; AR301 retains workload information there. In contrast, both CBU1503 leak->course_content flags are false alarms: their practical training descriptions properly belong in teaching_methods.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The FHS initial block defaults to course_content and Utfyllende informasjon om emnet maps unconditionally to course_content. Paragraphs about teaching, assessment and workload inherit these container labels regardless of meaning.
findings.suggested_fix: Route FHS supplemental and initial paragraphs by explicit bounded labels and lead-ins: Praktisk organisering og arbeidsformer and Pedagogisk innretning to teaching_methods, assessed-proposal instructions to assessment, and workload-only information to no section. Retain topic descriptions as course_content and avoid copying the same teaching passage into two sections.

findings.evidence:
Målgruppe
Emnet tilbys studenter ved Etterretningsskolen med fordypning i arabisk. Emnet er ikke tilgjengelig for emnestudenter.
findings.description: Four offerings (OPG3701, AR301, SPR2710 and SPR2711) include target-group/programme-admission restrictions in course_content. These statements concern who may take the course, rather than its subject matter, and should remain only in the full plan. They are unflagged.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Målgruppe is unmapped or absent from the heading list, so its admission paragraph is appended to the initial course_content block.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognise the FHS Målgruppe label and terminate course_content there. Map admission-only target-group blocks to .drop, stopping at the next actual section label; retain Forkunnskapskrav sentences about passed courses.

findings.evidence: Oppgavens omfang for 3 kadetter som skriver sammen, skal være på maksimum 12000 ord.
findings.description: OPG3302 coursework_requirements mix genuine preparatory proposal requirements with the final graded thesis submission and its 12000/8000-word limits. The assessment row contains only the brief form, duration, scale and weight. Final deliverable design belongs in assessment even when listed under Arbeidskrav; this error is invisible to its empty reading-list flag.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The mapped Arbeidskrav subheading assigns all following paragraphs to coursework_requirements, and post-processing does not move final-thesis specifications back into assessment.
findings.suggested_fix: Within FHS thesis Arbeidskrav blocks, move the final written deliverable and its word-limit paragraphs into assessment. Keep proposal approval and other explicitly preparatory requirements in coursework_requirements; do not reclassify the whole block.

findings.evidence: Prosjektbeskrivelsen skal være godkjent før arbeidet med bacheloroppgaven kan påbegynnes. Student og veileder skal inngå en skriftlig veiledningsavtale og sette opp en møteplan.
findings.description: The complete 177-character teaching_methods and coursework_requirements rows are identical, confirming dup_in_course. Project-description approval is an approval gate, not a teaching method. Supervision-agreement and meeting-plan arrangements should be assigned once by meaning rather than duplicated with the gate sentence.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The source places the gate under Læringsaktiviteter. R/extract_sections.R .split_inline_coursework() can retain a gate sentence when its graded-component matcher also fires, while appending it to coursework_requirements; the repeated output indicates an overbroad retain-and-copy decision or source repetition that is not resolved.
findings.suggested_fix: For this FHS gate, move the project-description approval sentence only to coursework_requirements and retain supervision arrangements only in teaching_methods. Narrow any graded-component exception so a reference to bacheloroppgaven does not itself make a gate grade-bearing, and remove exact cross-section copies after routing.

findings.evidence: Eksamen sensureres av to sensorer. Sensorene setter karakterene i fellesskap.
findings.description: Assessment retains examiner arrangements in AR301 and random SPR2721, and SPR2721 also retains a resit rule. OPG3701, SPR2710 and SPR2711 tables retain Tidspunkt/assessment-semester cells; AR301 and SPR2711 additionally repeat assessment-semester notices in prose, and CBU1503 includes its assessment semester inline. These are excluded logistics/administration. Durations, scales, weights, permitted aids and individual/group design are valid assessment content and should stay.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Assessment cleanup in R/extract_sections.R does not fully recognise these FHS narrative examiner/resit rules or strip semester columns from the older assessment tables.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove FHS examiner-arrangement and resit sentences and assessment-semester-only notices. Parse tabular rows to omit Tidspunkt and its corresponding cells while preserving the assessment form, duration, grading scale and weight; remove only the semester clause from mixed design sentences.

findings.evidence:
**course_content** (12 chars)  ⚑ flags: empty

````
Hva lærer du
findings.description: The empty flags identify genuine placeholder rows: CBU1506 has Må bestås as outcomes and teaching, and Blir publisert as readings; LED3201 has Avklares; LOG3105 has TBN.; ING2318 and MILM3404 have Kunngjøres. SPR2723 emits only the Hva lærer du label as course_content despite having no substantive section text. OPG3302 reading_list = Selvvalgt is a false-positive flag because it specifies self-selected literature.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R placeholder patterns omit these institution-specific bare values. The unmapped introductory Hva lærer du label survives in the default course_content row even when its block has no body.
findings.suggested_fix: Add whole-row, section-aware placeholder rules for Blir publisert, Avklares, TBN. and Kunngjøres, and bare Må bestås in outcomes/teaching. Suppress a course_content row consisting only of Hva lærer du. Preserve Selvvalgt and genuine pass/fail assessment descriptions.

findings.evidence: En obligatorisk veiledningsseanse i løpet av semesteret.
findings.description: The random Cybermakt control explicitly requires a compulsory supervision session inside assessment, but no coursework_requirements row is emitted. This mandatory activity is distinct from the graded report and oral presentation and should be separated from assessment. The pre-pass does not flag the omission.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The inline coursework splitter recognises specific gate/attendance sentences and labels, but misses a short compulsory-supervision sentence embedded in an assessment paragraph.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognise the bounded compulsory-supervision sentence as coursework_requirements and remove it from assessment while preserving the report, presentation/hearing and rules requiring both graded components to pass.
